effect.draw-one.description: When you confirm this Event card, draw one card from the deck into your hand. If the deck is empty, nothing is drawn. Discarding does not trigger this effect.

effect.free-action.description: When you confirm this Event card, it does not count as one of your two actions this turn. You can still take up to two other actions.
effect.free-action.name: Free action
effect.timeline-1900-bonus.description: Worth 1 extra point to the player who played this card if its timeline includes a 1900 Event card. Follow the arrows from 1900 to this card; a separate branch does not qualify. Each card awards this bonus only once.
effect.timeline-1900-bonus.name: 1900 timeline bonus

log.help: The JSON log includes the initial seed, player count, starting player, and current card uses. Undo/redo operations and draft movements are not exported. Paste a log to recreate the game. Leave the action count blank for the latest confirmed state, or use 0 for the initial deal. Computers stay paused until resumed. Replays require matching game rules and card definitions. Logs reveal all hands and the deck order.
log.overview: Card uses are listed in order. Undo removes a card use and redo restores it; neither is a log entry. Computers stay paused while you inspect the log.
log.started: Game started. {player} takes the first turn.
log.title: Game Log
manipulation.choose: Choose an Event card on the board. The starting card cannot be targeted.
manipulation.jumpDestination: Choose a highlighted empty position or removed Event to complete Time Jump.
manipulation.noTargets: No legal targets for this card. Select another card or discard it.
manipulation.remove-event.description: Mark an Event as removed. It stays on the board but scores no points or bonuses and no longer qualifies as a 1900 bonus source. It can still be moved, swapped, or overwritten with a valid Event. The starting card cannot be targeted.
manipulation.remove-event.name: Remove Event
manipulation.swapDestination: Choose a highlighted second Event card to complete Time Swap.
manipulation.take-control.description: Gain control of another player's Event card. Its points and any valid bonus become yours. A removed Event stays removed. The starting card cannot be targeted.
manipulation.take-control.name: Take Control
manipulation.time-jump.description: Move an Event card to a valid empty position or overwrite a removed Event. Empty destinations cannot touch another removed Event. A removed card can establish new links to earlier-dated active neighbors even if they were played after it. An overwrite preserves the destination's link directions and discards the replaced Event. Ownership and removed status stay with the moved card. The entire board must remain legal. The starting card cannot move.
manipulation.time-jump.name: Time Jump
manipulation.time-swap.description: Swap two Event cards while keeping the board legal. The starting card cannot be swapped.
manipulation.time-swap.name: Time Swap
